content: Implement the first M0130 W0131 Vulkan capability/ABI slice: declare Vulkan headers, loader, validation tools, and capability probing in the toolchain; define a truthful Vulkan 1.3 compute capability profile and target-environment serialization; and verify it on the current AMD host without claiming dual-driver qualification.

Content revision 837619a adds the optional Vulkan capability backend, fixed C ABI profile, target-environment SHA-256 digest, C/C++ ABI tests, CMake option and presets, and the named Nix vulkan-tools package/shell. Agent Harness (codex) is both commit author and committer.

Nix materialization passed for metaflux-vulkan-tools-1.4.341.0 at /nix/store/85p5k5gdff9rfzzjk0pwx3gz9lblnvcd-metaflux-vulkan-tools-1.4.341.0. The vulkan preset configured and built with C++20; full Vulkan CTest passed 81/81, including the ABI and capability tests. Agent records and diff checks passed.

The current AMD host has no discoverable Vulkan ICD (vulkaninfo reports missing libvulkan_radeon.so), so the probe returns no-device and the local regression exits successfully as not qualified on this host. No physical driver-family or dual-driver qualification is claimed; packed BDA ABI, lowering, execution, cache, memory import, and lifecycle gates remain open.
